messages.subject: Re: How to run UI and server file
parts:
If you place your files in a directory called myapp/, you would run it with:
  runApp('myapp')

Or you could do:
  runApp('/path/to/myapp')

I would suggest that you not put them in the examples directory; not only is this meant just for examples, it will be removed and overwritten whenever you update the Shiny package to a new version.

-Winston
